payload.body_they: {{Name}} takes the practical side of commitment seriously because they understand that another person's schedule, money, responsibilities, and limits eventually affect the relationship too. They can be exceptionally reliable once the easy part is over. The complication begins when dependability turns into handling whatever would otherwise be left undone. Being able to carry something does not automatically make it theirs to carry. A relationship that lasts should eventually show them what the other person is willing to carry too.
